how_to_fill: status = done, na (with a reason in note) or skipped. A rule you did not apply is skipped, not done.

items.check: Rules read in this chat from RULES_CFB_2H_CURRENT.md and the tab text (CFB_2H_tab.txt or the doc tab), not from memory notes
Canary line printed first, once per time window
Halftime confirmed on the scoreboard and FLOW pulled with get_football_drives for every game; FLOW table printed; clean margin or FLOW DATA GAP
Per-game run order followed; time left to the 3Q kickoff stated; nothing recommended after the kickoff
First-half handoff ingested when one exists; 2H-KICK named or UNKNOWN
Outside books pulled and listed (two or more, same number, de-vigged); DSB, Red105 and Robinhood kept out of the consensus
Price test run at every venue with a 2H market: DSB, Red105 and the Robinhood ladders (ask + 2 cents); 3.0-point floor applied
Executability stated: quote ages, fillable size, Robinhood bid-ask; otherwise SHADOW with EXEC UNVERIFIED
Robinhood: settlement, strike convention and tie handling stated; ask cap 60 cents; converted spread strikes tagged OFF-STRIKE
No total priced or fired at a number other than the consensus number
Size and caps applied; window exposure printed; one wager per game
Pre-ticket re-pull and news check done for every fire
Anchor printed as reference only; it triggered nothing
Blowout rule applied to every game (28+ / 21 to 27)
QB status printed with source and time for both teams
Weather pulled for the 2H start hour; wind gate applied to totals
Market status and stale-line checks made
Opener gates printed as PASS, FAIL or UNVERIFIED
Ledger line printed: live record, ROI, shadow n, mode
Tier recorded for every game
CLEAR LEAN test printed for every game: three inputs, split, hard counters
Every printed lean carries venue price, fair and the tag BETTABLE or PRICE WORSE THAN FAIR - pass
Shadow columns printed
First-observed, decision and executed quotes logged with times; the 3Q-kickoff line owed or pulled
Section 6 output format used; RECOMMENDED printed with ENGINE then MATCHUP LEAN; shadow log printed
Grades and closing lines owed from the previous board pulled, or listed as owed
Every fire, lean, shadow and conditional written to the log with number, price, venue and time
